event: Monday of week three: the morning after the storm is washed clean, blue and cold and very still.
The mere is flat again, littered with branches; the fells are back, sharp, snow on the tops.

memory.fact: The morning after the first storm the sky was clear, and the first snow lay on the fell tops.

event: At the boathouse the swimmers are back on; you and Shiv swim out to the buoy through floating twigs.

memory.fact: Shiv signed the swimmers' register under Nala after the storm: Doyle, and a drawn lightning cloud.
Shiv signed the swimmers' register under Nala after the storm: Doyle, and a drawn lightning cloud.

event: "Better than a storm," Shiv says, hanging there. "Worse than a rock." She splashes you, grinning.

memory.fact: At the buoy after the storm Shiv said: better than a storm, worse than a rock, and splashed Nala.
At the buoy after the storm Shiv said: better than a storm, worse than a rock, and splashed Nala.

event: Bea's door opens as you come up: Kit comes out first, in Bea's jumper over her own black skirt.
Kit sees you and holds her chin up. "I'll return it," she says, of the jumper. Bea snorts.

memory.fact: Kit came out of Bea's room on Monday in Bea's cream jumper, and told Nala she'd return it.

event: The three of you walk to breakfast together across the drying quad, Bea in the middle, talking.

memory.fact: The morning after the first storm the sky was clear, and the first snow lay on the fell tops.

event: Amara, at the hall doors, watches Kit arrive from Thornfield in a cream jumper, and raises a brow.
"Ashworth," she says, delighted. "Wool. Cream. Whatever next." Kit walks past her like a queen.

memory.fact: Seeing Kit in Bea's cream jumper, Amara said: Ashworth. Wool. Cream. Whatever next. Kit walked on.

event: In the top corridor a glazier from Kendal is fitting new glass in the end window, whistling.
Yusra stands by him with a list, her palm bandaged white; she sees you and lifts the hand slightly.
"Healing," she says. "Clean cut. You did right." Then, to the glazier: "Double-check that frame."

memory.fact: Yusra's cut palm is bandaged and healing clean; she showed Nala and told her: You did right.
Yusra's cut palm is bandaged and healing clean; she showed Nala and told her: You did right.
A glazier from Kendal mends Thornfield's storm-broken window on the Monday after the gale.

event: Ten: the Foundations lecture in the Long Room, on mending: why a broken thing wants to be whole.

memory.fact: Mending is easier than making: a cracked cup remembers being whole, and the charm reminds it.
Mending is easier than making: a cracked cup remembers being whole, and the charm reminds it.

event: Kit sits beside you; Lin on your other side, drawing the lecturer's hands in your margin.

memory.fact: In the mending lecture Lin drew the lecturer's hands in pencil in the margin of Nala's page.
In the mending lecture Lin drew the lecturer's hands in pencil in the margin of Nala's page.

event: Two: the Practice Hall; a cracked teacup on every bench, and the mending sigil chalked on the board.

memory.fact: In week three practical casting adds the mending charm: a cracked cup drawn whole again.
In week three practical casting adds the mending charm: a cracked cup drawn whole again.

event: The demonstrator claps for quiet: on Friday, each first-year casts a glim and warms a stone.

memory.fact: On week three's Friday each first-year casts a glim and warms a stone before the hall, as a test.

Week three's Friday test is at two: glim first, then a stone, one at a time before the hall.

event: "Before the whole hall," she says. "One at a time. It's a test. Everyone passes who's practised."
Beside you, Kit's face goes perfectly still, and her hand on the bench goes white at the knuckles.
You try the mending charm; your crack closes halfway along, and stops, a seam you can see.

memory.fact: Nala's first mending charm closed her cup's crack only halfway, leaving a pale seam like a scar.

event: Bea's cup gets warm instead of mended; she stares at it. "That's the wrong spell," she whispers.

memory.fact: Bea's first mending charm warmed her cracked cup instead; That's the wrong spell, she whispered.
Bea's first mending charm warmed her cracked cup instead; That's the wrong spell, she whispered.

event: At the end bench, back to the room, Kit's cup goes whole in one smooth breath, without a seam.

memory.fact: Unwatched at the end bench, Kit mended her cracked cup in one breath, without a seam.
Unwatched at the end bench, Kit mended her cracked cup in one breath, without a seam.

event: After practical Kit walks out fast, across the quad and down to the shore; you follow her.
At the water she stops. "Before the whole hall," she says. "I'll freeze. You've seen me freeze."
"My mother will hear. She hears everything. An Ashworth who can't cast a glim in front of people."

memory.fact: Kit told Nala she'll freeze at Friday's test, and her mother will hear an Ashworth can't cast.
Kit told Nala she'll freeze at Friday's test, and her mother will hear an Ashworth can't cast.

event: You stand beside her at the water and say: then we practise being watched. A bit more each day.
"One pair of eyes," you say. "Mine. Then more." Kit looks at you a long time. "Yours."

memory.fact: Nala offered to practise Kit at being watched, her eyes first, then more; Kit said: Yours.
Nala offered to practise Kit at being watched, her eyes first, then more; Kit said: Yours.

event: Dusk: the empty Practice Hall, where you once saw her ring of glims through the window.
You sit at the far end, back to her; behind you Kit's glim rises, steady; you see its light.
You turn sideways, looking at the wall; she casts again, and it holds, a little smaller.

memory.fact: In the empty hall at dusk Kit cast a steady glim at Nala's back, then a smaller one at her side.
In the empty hall at dusk Kit cast a steady glim at Nala's back, then a smaller one at her side.

event: You turn and look at her. Kit draws the sigil, says the word, and freezes, her hand in the air.
Her face goes white; you keep looking, gently, and say her name, and say breathe out.
She breathes out. A flicker of light: half a glim, wavering, gone in a second. But it was there.

memory.fact: Watched by Nala, Kit froze, then breathed out at her word and made half a glim for a second.
Watched by Nala, Kit froze, then breathed out at her word and made half a glim for a second.

event: Kit stares at the empty air where it was. Then she laughs, shaky. "That was terrible," she says.
"That was the first one," you say. She kisses you hard in the dark hall, once. "Tomorrow," she says.

memory.fact: After that half glim Kit kissed Nala hard, once, in the dark hall, and said: Tomorrow.
After that half glim Kit kissed Nala hard, once, in the dark hall, and said: Tomorrow.

event: At ten Priya bursts into the Thornfield kitchen, back from charmcraft, glowing about clockwork.
"Amara came," she says. "To charmcraft. She hates clockwork. She said so. Twice. And she stayed."

memory.fact: Amara went to charmcraft with Priya, said twice she hates clockwork, and stayed the two hours.

event: Priya sits down very suddenly and stares at her cocoa. Bea pats her hand, quietly.

memory.fact: Telling of Amara at charmcraft, Priya went quiet over her cocoa; Bea patted her hand and kept it.

event: In 14 you write a list on the back of your timetable: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday. Kit. Hall.
Under it, smaller: Friday. Then, smallest, for yourself: breathe out.

memory.fact: On her timetable's back Nala wrote: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday. Kit. Hall. Friday. breathe out.
